purpose: Make recovered lens/optics capabilities legible and composable across FIELD surfaces without replacing Scale Lens Studio or creating another sovereign application.

current_head.constraint: preserve parser, stable identity/address, provenance, receipts, projections and RETURN

exact_or_directly_recovered: functional optics: Lens / Iso / fov / get / set / mod(over)
Scale Lens RC9→RC11.2: stable focus, semantic scale ladders, projection, provenance, RETURN
AXIAL aperture contract: APERTURE changes visible scope, never canonical identity
reconstructed_or_partial: older FOCUS RING / foveation interaction lineage; exact artifact still needs recovery
unknown: SeeThings implementation: name/hidden-focus association recovered, concrete mechanism not yet recovered

DATA_LENS.meaning: getter/setter optic focused into canonical data
laws: GetPut: putting back what was read leaves the source observationally unchanged
PutGet: reading after a put returns the value that was put
PutPut: consecutive puts collapse to the last put
DATA_LENS.note: These laws apply to data optics; do not pretend every visual projection has getter/setter semantics.

VIEW_LENS.meaning: pure/preview projection over an addressed object or range
laws: IDENTITY: projection never invents or silently changes canonical identity
PURITY: same source + params + lens version gives the same derived view
BOUNDEDNESS: aperture declares the range it reveals/suppresses
PROVENANCE: derived marks retain source/range + transform chain
NO_SILENT_MUTATION: moving, resizing, zooming, filtering or stacking view lenses does not COMMIT
RETURNABILITY: every entered lens state has an explicit re-entry/return address
PLAIN_BASELINE: any promoted projection keeps a plain readable baseline reachable

ACTION_TOOLGLASS.meaning: click/tap-through operator that may change canonical state
laws: authority is explicit and visible before consequence
rollback is compensating RETURN, never history erasure

composition.rule: composition is ordered, typed and inspectable; L2∘L1 is not assumed equivalent to L1∘L2
composition.compound_lens: a named, saveable stack plus order and parameters; loading it is preview until an action lens explicitly commits
composition.receipt: save source identity/address, aperture, ordered stack, params, result projection and return address

canonical_state.focus_id: selected identity within the current projection

aperture.shape: surface-specific; geometry is projection, not ontology

canonical_state.projection: SOURCE | STRUCTURE | RELATION | TIME | STATE | PROVENANCE | surface-specific extension
canonical_state.lens_stack: ordered VIEW_LENS and optional ACTION_TOOLGLASS descriptors
canonical_state.operator: SELECT | ALIGN | COMPOSE | PROPAGATE | COMMIT | RETURN

focus_ring_v0.status: PROPOSED_FROM_RECOVERED_LINEAGE; exact older ring still to recover
focus_ring_v0.role: small common controller in front of Scale Studio, not a replacement for Studio
focus_ring_v0.default_surface: collapsed ◎ LENS aperture from global route adapter

visible_model.in_out: APERTURE finer/coarser while preserving focus identity
visible_model.left_right: previous/next lawful peer at the current level
visible_model.rim: projection chooser; labels always visible when open
visible_model.stack: COMPOSE opens a compact ordered lens-stack sheet
visible_model.return: persistent RETURN control to exact invoking route

interaction_constraints: phone: one-thumb operable; no essential hover
desktop: may become movable Toolglass but shares the same LensState
do not overload gaze as primary input
all gesture-only actions also have visible controls/keyboard paths
browser/accessibility focus indicator remains distinct from conceptual FOCUS RING state

foveation_v0.meaning: allocate representation detail by semantic/structural distance from focus, not merely geometric magnification

bands.PARA: parents, siblings, accepted relations and immediate context
bands.PERIPHERY: coarse headings/counts/topology/route cues sufficient for orientation

rules: semantic zoom changes representation at declared thresholds; it does not merely enlarge text
context has a legibility floor; below it switch to overview/detail or progressive disclosure instead of decorative compression
fisheye distortion is optional and task-proven, never the default
focus movement preserves identity and orientation cues

promotion_targets.name: Shared LensState + composition contract
promotion_targets.delta: one schema/adapter usable by Scale Lens, FIELD, Human Port and AXIAL without merging their UIs
promotion_targets.proof: same object + same ordered view stack serializes/restores identically on at least two surfaces

promotion_targets.name: FOCUS RING aperture HUD
promotion_targets.delta: global ◎ LENS opens focus/scope/projection/stack/RETURN without entering full Studio
promotion_targets.proof: mobile and desktop: find current identity, change scope, switch projection, RETURN in <=2 interactions per operation; no horizontal overflow

promotion_targets.name: Foveated FIELD proof
promotion_targets.delta: one existing FIELD/graph surface renders FOVEA/PARA/PERIPHERY while preserving stable identity
promotion_targets.proof: paired plain baseline test for locate/context/return; promote only if it reduces steps/errors or improves context without harming orientation

gaps: no shared typed LensState/compound-lens schema exists in master
no recovered repo implementation of older FOCUS RING/foveation donor yet
Scale Studio exposes operators but composition is not yet a legible saved lens stack
no cross-surface task benchmark has yet earned promotion of fisheye/foveation over plain baseline
SeeThings remains an unresolved retrieval anchor rather than a mechanism
non_goals: do not make geometry itself canonical state
do not let projection own FIELD state
do not silently conflate view filters with mutating optics/actions
do not delete deep Scale Studio capability

return.next: Implement LENS-01 adapter + serializer first; then make LENS-02 read/write that state without touching RC11.2 internals.
return.test_anchor: Issue #10 REP-01 can serve as the cross-projection fixture; Issue #35 remains the Scale Lens aperture/UX convergence front.
